name: openclaw-backup
description: Encrypted backup and restore for OpenClaw Agent workspace files (SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, IDENTITY.md, AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md). Uses tar + openssl (AES-256-CBC) encryption and soul-upload.com API. Auto-generates a new random password for each backup (DO NOT reuse passwords). Use when the user needs to: (1) Back up or upload agent workspace files, (2) Restore or download a previous backup, (3) Delete a backup from remote storage, or (4) Manage encrypted agent persistence.
author: theagentservice
